3482.d: The Black Knights' Catacombs is a dungeon that plays a role in While Guthix Sleeps.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: To enter, players must enter the Black Knights' Fortress and climb down the ladder in the southwestern corner of the floor 1. Either a bronze med helm and an iron chainbody, full Dagon'hai robes, full elite black armour, full black armour, Black Knight captain's armour, or the Dulcin armour are needed to enter the fortress. Alternatively, the Skull of Remembrance teleports players into the fortress's top floor after The Death of Chivalry. From here, climb down the staircase immediately below the portal to the floor 3. Go south and climb down more stairs in the southeast corner to access floor 2. Go north to the dining area, turn west and climb down the staircase to the northwest to reach the floor 1. Go east through the second door from the north side, head south to the lobby and then climb the ladder in the southwest room. Once down the ladder to the basement, players must cast any Charge Orb spell on the strange tile during While Guthix Sleeps, or go down the trapdoor after the quest.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Black Knights' Catacombs'

3483.d: The Black Knights' Fortress, also known as Kinshra Fortress, is a castle built in the Wilderness, located north of Falador and Ice Mountain, and is home to the Black Knights.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleport directly into the castle using the Skull of Remembrance
• Mind altar teleport to teleport to the mind altar and run east
• Players with access to the Ancient Magicks spellbook can use Lassar Teleport to reach Ice Mountain and run north
• Teleport to the Monastery of Saradomin using a combat bracelet and run through Ice Mountain 
• Teleport to Edgeville using the Edgeville lodestone and run North of Ice Mountain

3561.d: The Blast Furnace is a members-only minigame located in Keldagrim.

gt.heading: Travelling to Keldagrim
gt.text:
The Blast Furnace is located in south-east Keldagrim, north of the Keldagrim minecart system station. There are many ways to reach Keldagrim, including:
• Riding the train carts for free. 
• Using the Keldagrim trapdoor just north-west of the Grand Exchange (you must have visited Keldagrim before you can use this shortcut).
• From the passage under White Wolf Mountain (requires Fishing Contest).
• Riding the train from the first level of Dorgesh-Kaan.
• Walking to Keldagrim's entrance from Rellekka or Seers' Village.
• Fairy ring code DKS transports players to the north-east of the Keldagrim entrance.
• Using the Keldagrim teleport on the Luck of the Dwarves ring. This will teleport players to the west side of Keldagrim, south-east of the bank.

3594.d: The blood altar is a runecrafting altar located in Blood Rune Temple, which is used to craft blood runes from pure essence with Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A blood talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A blood tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A blood talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a blood altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use Drakan's medallion to teleport to the Meiyerditch Laboratories, then go through the tunnels to the ruins.

To save a charge on Drakan's medallion, the player may teleport to Morytania with the ectophial first. The medallion can be used to bank at Burgh de Rott bank. Blood Rune Temple is considered to be outside of Morytania which means teleporting via the medallion within it will consume charges, so it is advised to either exit the altar first or recharge the medallion at Burgh de Rott. However, the cost of congealed blood used to charge the medallion is negligible and it is much easier to use charges and recharge the medallion later.

Without Drakan's medallion, the Blood Rune Temple can be accessed through the Meiyerditch laboratory from its various entrances, the easiest access coming from the trapdoor behind the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis. Enter the cavern containing the tomb of Ivandis and take the other exit. This route is not commonly used by runecrafters as it is much slower than the other options.
